title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-19
lineage: Master/1st generation cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard (96Mhz/24 bit)> HD
source: Master Audience Cassette; Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic

ai_review.summary: Lively acoustic set with historic first performances captured in a good‑quality audience tape
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an energetic acoustic set—including the debut of Ripple, Brokedown Palace, Operator and Truckin'—followed by a strong electric portion. Reviewers praise the overall sound as clear and enjoyable despite occasional variability, and note the fun, slightly sloppy but heartfelt vibe of the hometown show.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 4‑5 stars) and enthusiastic comments about both performance milestones and sound quality lead to a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and lively tape; reviewers note the sound is solid for an audience source, with only minor occasional muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set opens the show with historic first‑time renditions, then transitions into a classic electric second set that maintains high energy and fan‑favorite sequences.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pig (Ron "Pig" McKernan) provides piano on How Long Blues, noted as a pleasant surprise by listeners.
